For consistency with other test files in this pull request and for better readability, please consider re-adding `import com.google.firebase.firestore.pipeline.Expression.Companion.nullValue` and using `nullValue()` without qualification throughout this file. This would align the style with files like `RealtimePipelineTest.kt` and `NestedPropertiesTests.kt`.

```suggestion
        .where(or(field("a").equal(constant(1L)), field("a").equal(nullValue())))
```
